```python
def solve(case):
    payload = case.get("payload", case)
    segments = payload["segments"]
    budget = payload["budget"]
    
    # Validate required fields
    for seg in segments:
        for field in ("name", "importance", "minimum", "capacity"):
            if field not in seg:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field '{field}' in segment")
    
    # Initialize allocations at minimum quota
    allocs = [seg["minimum"] for seg in segments]
    quota_sum = sum(allocs)
    cap_sum = sum(seg["capacity"] for seg in segments)
    
    # Validate budget bounds
    if budget < quota_sum:
        raise ValueError(f"Budget {budget} is below minimum quota sum {quota_sum}")
    if budget > cap_sum:
        raise ValueError(f"Budget {budget} exceeds total capacity {cap_sum}")
    
    remaining = budget - quota_sum
    
    # Greedily allocate remaining budget
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_priority = None
        for i, seg in enumerate(segments):
            if allocs[i] >= seg["capacity"]:
                continue
            # Priority = importance / next allocated position
            priority = seg["importance"] / (allocs[i] + 1)
            if best_idx == -1 or priority > best_priority:
                best_priority = priority
                best_idx = i
        if best_idx == -1:
            break  # No eligible segments (shouldn't happen if budget <= cap_sum)
        allocs[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    
    # Build result
    allocations = {seg["name"]: allocs[i] for i, seg in enumerate(segments)}
    name_mapping = {seg["name"]: seg["name"] for i, seg in enumerate(segments)}
    
    return {
        "allocations": allocations,
        "name_mapping": name_mapping,
        "total": sum(allocs)
    }
```
